{{Otheruses|Bantha}}
'''Bantha four five six''' was an instruction code given by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[TDL-3.5]] as authorization for her to replace [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] as nanny to the [[Solo twins]]. However, [[Winter Celchu|Winter]] realized that ''bantha'' was not a family code, and that it was a prank by [[Anakin Solo]] who had been upset because C-3PO refused to read his favorite bedtime story; ''[[The Little Lost Bantha Cub]]''.
